arguments.command:
@'
import difflib
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(r'src\click\shell_completion.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/shell_completion.py']).splitlines(keepends=True)
current = p.read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True)
matcher = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, [s.rstrip(b'\r\n') for s in original], [s.rstrip(b'\r\n') for s in current], autojunk=False)
for tag, a, b, c, d in reversed(matcher.get_opcodes()):
    if tag == 'equal':
        current[c:d] = original[a:b]
p.write_bytes(b''.join(current))
'@ | python -; git --no-pager diff --check && git --no-pager diff --stat
